items.reason: Pinning a tag to a commit SHA means asking GitHub what the tag points at right now, and this session has no network; scripts/actions-pin.mjs --update already does exactly this burn-down (and raises its own RATCHET.pinned in the same pass), so there was no useful adjacent artefact to add.

Already covered: .github/guidance-budget.json declares the seven READ-FIRST documents with a per-file and total line ceiling, scripts/guidance-budget.mjs measures it, and test-unit/guidance-budget.test.mjs blocks on every build — editing anything here would have been work for the scanner rather than for the repository.

Already covered: .husky/commit-msg runs scripts/commit-check.mjs on the message file and exits 1 on an A5 violation, and scripts/install-commit-hooks.mjs installs it from package.json `prepare`, so the rule now fires while the message is still editable; the residual hole is a throwaway lane worktree where nobody ran npm install, which no repository-side change can close.

Already covered: scripts/adr-check.mjs rule 7 requires a non-placeholder `## Revisit when` section on EVERY record (blocking, inside check:ci) and all twelve ADRs carry one, including ADR-0008's no-formatter stance.

The ADR-0001 invariants are now one contract executed against both drivers in one process — cases live once in test-unit/store-contract.mjs and the two runner suites run them against sqlite and the Firestore fake, then deep-compare what each driver answered.

A release that aborts itself needs a health signal and window the team accepts, Vercel deployment credentials to read and roll back with, and the authority to push a revert to master — all three are on this repository's red list for an unattended agent (AGENTS.md § Red) and none of them is reachable without network or an operator decision.

The strict measurement is now taken per seam as well as in total: six load-bearing seams are declared in .github/typecheck-strict.json, printed on every run, pinned by the same --accept, and a seam over its pin is reported even when the total fell.

lessons: This repository closes its own gaps fast: three of the seven dispatched items (guidance budget, commit-msg hook, ADR revisit conditions) were already implemented and enforced by a blocking gate before the scan's findings were dispatched. Read the gate scripts and .github/*.json registries before writing anything — a plausible-looking gap here is usually a scan that ran on an older tree.

When adding a test to a repository whose conventions are this dense, check the registries that count things (scripts/agent-surface.mjs's unmapped ratchet, .github/test-tiers.json's census, the contract ledger's discovery sources) before adding a file: several of them turn a new path into a red build, and which ones do is not guessable from the file's location.
